rules.rule: Check changed instructions and documents against actual behavior, requirements and linked sources. Identify contradictions, missing required artifacts and broken references. Preserve the project's document templates and tone; report only concrete defects.

Check valid configuration and consistency with this repository: roles coor/designer/dev/ops/tester, fullops/<role> branches, origin/main, actual project phase status, and no secrets. Product planning belongs to designer; technical design and implementation belong to dev.
